actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item .mmRend0000000000]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) [[/item .mmParalyzingBrea]] or (B) Spellcasting to cast [[/item .mmSpellcasting00.Activity.DJGcakjcAlCCOOFg]] (level 2 version).

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: cold breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=8P7hmd3Nron4RAIv]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=8P7hmd3Nron4RAIv]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=8P7hmd3Nron4RAIv]]-foot Cone. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: paralyzing breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=r4MGqEq5U9aaseBh]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=r4MGqEq5U9aaseBh]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=r4MGqEq5U9aaseBh]]-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +15 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHoldMonste]{Hold Monster}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIceKnife00]{Ice Knife} (level 2 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShapechang]{Shapechange} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell) 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplControlWea]{Control Weather}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIceStorm00]{Ice Storm} (level 7 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTeleport00]{Teleport}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplZoneofTrut]{Zone of Truth}

actions.name: chill
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast [[/item .mmSpellcasting00.Activity.2CC68ooxyWo6GXU4]]. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: cold gale
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=pVs8BTVDNh54CZ0a]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=pVs8BTVDNh54CZ0a]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=pVs8BTVDNh54CZ0a]]-foot-wide Line. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.
